en_quote: A regulator’s role is to set detailed rules, ensure they are followed, and ensure that the preventative controls in the private sector are effective.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构的职责是制定详细规则、确保遵守并保证私营部门预防性控制有效

en_quote: Regulators authorize regulated businesses via licenses and registrations and then undertake risk-based supervision of these organizations to ensure compliance and identify noncompliance.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构通过许可和注册授权受监管实体，并开展风险为本的监督

en_quote: Regulators have a range of tools to ensure compliance, up to and including issuing fines and enforcement actions for serious cases.
knowledge_zh: 监管机构拥有多种合规工具，包括罚款和执法行动

en_quote: Law enforcement undertakes investigations to bring money launderers to justice, take away their assets, and achieve other disruptive effects.
knowledge_zh: 执法部门开展调查以将洗钱者绳之以法并没收资产

en_quote: Law enforcement investigators work with prosecution authorities to bring court proceedings.
knowledge_zh: 执法调查人员与检察机关合作提起刑事诉讼

en_quote: The relationship between law enforcement and prosecution authorities varies significantly between jurisdictions, depending on the legal system in each jurisdiction.
knowledge_zh: 执法与检察机关的关系因司法管辖区法律体系而异

en_quote: Asset recovery is an important part of AML/CFT systems. Law enforcement and prosecution authorities use asset recovery as a mechanism to ensure that crime does not pay.
knowledge_zh: 资产追缴是反洗钱/反恐怖融资体系的重要组成部分，确保犯罪无利可图

en_quote: Depending on their location, law enforcement agencies have varying scopes of authority for addressing different types of crime.
knowledge_zh: 执法机构的权限范围因所在地和犯罪类型而异

en_quote: For example, local police have different responsibilities compared to national or federal agencies.
knowledge_zh: 例如地方警察与国家级或联邦机构的职责不同

en_quote: Some law enforcement agencies might also have other responsibilities.
knowledge_zh: 部分执法机构可能还承担其他职责

en_quote: For example, tax authorities can be responsible for investigating tax crime as well as setting tax policy.
knowledge_zh: 例如税务机关既负责调查税务犯罪也负责制定税收政策

en_quote: National FIUs receive, analyze, and disseminate financial intelligence.
knowledge_zh: 国家金融情报机构接收、分析和传播金融情报

en_quote: They produce strategic analysis that is used to understand trends, typologies, and threats.
knowledge_zh: FIU开展战略分析以了解趋势、类型和威胁

en_quote: They also produce operational analysis that law enforcement uses to investigate and disrupt money laundering, terrorist financing, and predicate offenses.
knowledge_zh: FIU开展操作分析供执法部门调查洗钱、恐怖融资和上游犯罪

en_quote: In some cases, the same organization can be both a regulator and an FIU, and FIUs can also be part of law enforcement agencies.
knowledge_zh: 同一机构可同时承担监管机构、金融情报机构和执法机构的角色

en_quote: There are many different models, but the main point is that the agencies cooperate and share information when it pertains to each other’s functions.
knowledge_zh: 各机构必须合作并共享与各自职能相关的信息

en_quote: These agencies should also share information with their international counterparts to handle crossborder money laundering and terrorist financing.
knowledge_zh: 机构应与国际同行共享信息以打击跨境洗钱和恐怖融资

en_quote: There are various channels for information sharing, depending on whether it is intelligence, evidence, or regulatory information.
knowledge_zh: 信息共享渠道因信息类型（情报、证据或监管信息）而异
